blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: We present MEMO (a Mesh for Every MOment), a method that reconstructs the geometry of complete dynamic scenes, captured by multiple synchronized cameras, and extracts a mesh at every frame. Existing dynamic Gaussian splatting methods either model appearance alone or target isolated objects segmented by foreground masks, and all of them recover meshes by TSDF fusion or Poisson reconstruction, whose fixed grids limit the detail they can capture. At the core of MEMO is a per-Gaussian motion model inspired by Gaussian processes, which represents each Gaussian's position and rotation over time as a combination of temporal Gaussian kernels. The model keeps every Gaussian a valid surface element throughout the sequence and carries an implicit representation of the dynamic geometry, so a mesh can be derived at any time from a field defined by the Gaussians. Although common in real captures, large and fast motion poses a challenge that dynamic Gaussian splatting methods usually overlook. To account for it, we design a track-based initialization scheme that fits each Gaussian's initial trajectory to point tracks in closed form. We evaluate MEMO on Blender-Moments, a new benchmark of nine animated scenes with ground-truth meshes at every frame, and on two real-world datasets. MEMO reconstructs the most accurate geometry among state-of-the-art methods, and remains competitive in novel-view synthesis and training time. Project page: https://memo-4d.github.io
blocks.zh: 我们提出MEMO(一种Mesh for Every Moment),这种方法重建了完整的动态场景的几何,被多台同步相机所捕获,并在每个帧取出一个网格. 已存在的动态高斯滑板方法要么是模式外观单独出现,要么是瞄准被前地口罩分割的被隔离的物体,所有它们都通过TSDF聚变或Poisson重建来取回中子,其固定网格限制了它们能够捕捉到的细节. MEMO的核心是受高斯进程所启发的每高斯运动模型,它代表了每个高斯人的位置并随时间而旋转,作为时间性高斯内核的组合. 该模型使每个高斯人在整个序列中都保持一个有效的地表元素,并带有动态几何的隐含表示,因此一个网格可以随时从高斯人定义的一字段得到. 虽然在真实的捕捉中很常见,但大而快的动作构成了一个挑战,动态高斯滑板方法通常会忽略. 为了说明这一点,我们设计了一个基于轨迹的初始化方案,这个方案适合每个高斯人的初始轨迹,以封闭的形式指向轨迹. 我们在Blender-Moments上对MEMO进行了评价,这是9个动画场景的新基准,每个场景都有地上真实的网格,以及两个现实世界的数据集。 MEMO在最先进的方法中重建了最准确的几何学,在小说视角综合和培训时间上仍然具有竞争力. 项目网页:https://memo-4d.github.io

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
Capturing a dynamic scene, a person in motion, a mechanism at work, or an animal on the move, and turning it into a digital asset is the first step toward bringing the physical world into the virtual world.
It is a long-standing goal of computer vision and graphics, and recent progress in novel-view synthesis has brought it within reach.
Neural radiance fields [ 47 ] first reconstructed static scenes from photographs with striking realism, and 3D Gaussian splatting [ 28 ] has since made it fast enough to become the representation of choice.
Dynamic variants of Gaussian splatting bring this to videos, allowing immersive rendering of the scene from novel views and camera trajectories.
However, these dynamic methods optimize for appearance, and the surfaces extracted from them are often noisy and incomplete.
This matters for downstream applications that need accurate per-frame geometry, like physical interaction with virtual objects, relighting, and AR/VR scene composition.
blocks.zh:
抓住一个动态的场景,一个运动中的人,一个工作机制,或者一个正在移动的动物,把它变成一个数字资产,是将物理世界带入虚拟世界的第一步.
这是计算机视觉和图形学的一个长期目标,而最近小说-视觉综合方面的进展使它可以实现.
神经发光场 [47] 最早从照片中重建出带有惊人现实主义的静态场景,而3D高斯克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克
高斯平板化的动态变体将这个带入了视频,允许从小说取景和相机轨迹来浸透地渲染场景.
然而,这些动态方法优化了外观,从中取取出的地表往往很吵而不完整.
这对下游的应用来说很重要,这些应用需要精确的每帧几何,例如与虚拟物体的物理交互,再光,以及AR/VR场景组成.

blocks.en:
Current dynamic Gaussian methods, whether built on deformation fields [ 70 , 73 ] , 4D primitives [ 74 ] , sparse control points [ 25 ] , or per-Gaussian trajectories [ 42 , 37 , 68 , 62 ] , encode appearance and motion but do not have a representation of the surface, either implicit or explicit.
To reconstruct the scene’s surfaces, a volume has to be built from the trained model after the fact, by TSDF volume integration [ 14 ] on depth maps rendered from many viewpoints and passed to marching cubes [ 41 ] on a fixed-resolution grid.
Since the optimization constrains geometry only through appearance, the models carry many floaters, which distort the input volumes of the marching cubes and lead to noisy reconstructions.
blocks.zh:
当前动态 高斯方法,无论是建立在变形场上[70,73],4D原始人[74],零星的控制点[25],还是每高斯人行道[42,37,68,62],编码外观和运动,但没有表层的表示,无论是隐含的还是明示的.
为了重建场景的地表,必须用经过训练的模型在从许多角度推导的深度地图上通过TSDF卷集成[14],然后通过固定分辨率网格上向行走立方体[41]来建造出一卷.
由于优化仅能通过外观来限制几何,这些模型会携带许多浮标,这扭曲了行走的立方体的输入量并导致噪音重建.

blocks.en:
For static scenes, this problem has been addressed by training Gaussians to represent geometry alongside appearance.
One family of methods regularizes the Gaussians so that their rendered depth, and hence its fusion, is accurate [ 24 , 10 , 80 ] .
A second family defines a field directly from the Gaussians and extracts its level set with marching tetrahedra [ 79 , 55 , 23 , 21 ] , which removes depth fusion altogether and adapts the mesh resolution to the Gaussians.
For dynamic scenes, the few methods that reconstruct surfaces [ 39 , 83 , 71 ] are object-centric, relying on foreground masks to isolate a single object, and remain slow to train.
blocks.zh:
对于静态场景来说,这个问题已经通过训练高斯人与外观一起代表几何来得到解决.
一个方法家族将高斯人正规化, 让他们的深度, 以及它的聚变, 是准确的 [24, 10, 80].
第二个家族直接从高斯人定义出一个场并取出它的平分,用行走的四面体[79, 55, 23, 21],完全去除深度聚变,使网格分辨率适应高斯人.
对于动态场景来说,重建表面的少数方法[39,83,71]是以物体为中心,依靠前地口罩来隔离出单个物体,并保持训练缓慢.

blocks.en:
In this work, we aim to bring the field-based extraction of the second family to complete, unmasked dynamic scenes captured by multiple synchronized cameras, allowing the full scene geometry to be extracted at every frame.
We build on three key insights.
First, every Gaussian must remain a valid surface element at every frame of the sequence.
Second, the model should carry an implicit representation of the scene’s dynamic geometry.
Third, training struggles to recover large and fast motion without a good starting point.
To realize the first two insights, we propose a per-Gaussian temporal motion model that represents each Gaussian’s changes in position and rotation over time as a linear combination of temporal Gaussian kernels, inspired by radial basis function (RBF) networks [ 5 , 49 ] and Gaussian processes (GPs) [ 56 ] .
To realize the third, we introduce a track-based initialization scheme that assigns each initial Gaussian a trajectory consistent with the observed motion.
blocks.zh:
在这部作品中,我们的目标是使第二家族的实地取出完成被多台同步相机所捕获的被解开的动态场景,使得每个帧都能够取出完整的场景几何.
我们基于三个主要见解。
首先,每个高斯人必须在序列的每一帧保持有效的表面元素.
第二,模型应隐含地表示场景的动态几何.
三是训练奋力恢复大而快的运动,没有良好的起步点.
为了实现前两个洞察力,我们提出一个每高斯人时间运动模型,代表每个高斯人随时间推移位置和旋转的变化,作为时间高斯内核的线性组合,受射线基础函数(RBF)网络[5,49]和高斯过程(GPs)[56]所启发.
为了实现第三个目标,我们引入了基于轨迹的初始化方案,为每一个初始高斯人分配出与所观测到的运动一致的轨迹.

blocks.en:
Since the temporal Gaussian kernels span the whole timeline, each Gaussian can follow complex motion and remains a valid surface element throughout the sequence.
It can therefore carry an implicit representation of the surface, such as oriented normals [ 21 ] , along its trajectory.
Polynomial trajectories [ 37 , 68 ] , in contrast, hold only within short time windows and introduce geometric noise outside them.
Since each trajectory is linear in its kernel weights, our initialization scheme fits it in closed form by GP regression to point tracks spanning the whole sequence, so even large and fast motion is captured from the start.
With our model, the surface is defined at any time, and a mesh follows at every frame from marching tetrahedra, with no depth rendering or fusion ( Fig. 1 ).
blocks.zh:
由于时间性高斯内核跨越了整个时间线,因此每个高斯内核都可以跟随复杂的运动,在整个序列中仍然是有效的表面元素.
因此,它可以沿其轨迹对地表进行隐含的表示,如方向常态[21].
相形之下,多音轨 [37,68] 相形之下,只在短时间窗口内保持,并在窗外引入几何噪声.
由于每个轨迹的内核重量都是线性的,所以我们的初始化方案通过GP回归使其以封闭的形式相适应来指向横跨整个序列的轨迹,所以即使是大而快的运动也从一开始就被捕获.
有了我们的模型,表面随时都会被定义,从行走的四面体到每个框架都有一个网状,没有深度渲染或聚变(图1).

blocks.en:
Evaluating dynamic geometry requires ground-truth meshes that evolve with the scene, and no public dataset pairs synchronized multi-camera captures with exact time-varying geometry.
We therefore build Blender-Moments, a benchmark of nine animated scenes, rendered from multiple synchronized cameras, whose ground-truth meshes can be extracted at any frame.
We evaluate our method on this new dataset and on two existing real-world datasets, Neural 3D Video [ 34 ] and SelfCap [ 72 ] , and compare it to state-of-the-art dynamic methods, including ones designed for surface reconstruction.
MEMO reconstructs the most accurate dynamic geometry, and its novel-view synthesis rivals that of the strongest baselines.
Its advantage is largest on scenes with large and fast motion.
It also trains in a time comparable to the fastest dynamic splatting methods.

blocks.en: In summary, our contributions are: • A framework for joint appearance and per-frame mesh reconstruction of complete dynamic scenes, achieving state-of-the-art surface reconstruction. • A novel motion model and initialization technique inspired by Gaussian processes. • A multi-view benchmark for dynamic surface reconstruction, with ground-truth meshes at every frame.

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en:
Novel-view synthesis methods such as neural radiance fields [ 47 ] and 3D Gaussian splatting [ 28 ] are optimized for appearance alone and do not model the scene’s geometry.
Many works have addressed this by extending these representations to recover surfaces.
For radiance fields, several works [ 64 , 76 , 36 , 67 ] map an implicit surface representation to volume density, so that volume rendering recovers the surface together with appearance.
For Gaussians, two classes of methods have emerged.
The first regularizes the Gaussians so that their rendered depth is accurate, and extracts meshes by TSDF volume integration of that depth.
2DGS [ 24 ] pioneered this class by flattening the Gaussians into 2D surfels with well-defined normals.
Later works adopt planar [ 10 ] or quadratic [ 85 ] primitives, rasterize depth and normals in closed form [ 80 ] , supervise normals with monocular priors [ 13 ] , or treat Gaussians as stochastic solids [ 81 ] .
blocks.zh:
小说-取景合成方法如神经光泽场[47]和3D高斯平板化[28]被优化,仅用于外观,不模拟场景几何.
许多作品都通过将这些表达方式扩展到恢复地表来解决这个问题.
对于发光地,有几部作品[64,76,36,67]将地表隐含的表示图映射到体积密度上,使体积渲染随外观一起恢复出地表.
对于高斯人来说,出现了两类方法.
第一种将高斯人正规化,使他们的渲染深度准确,并通过TSDF的体积集成来取出中层.
2DGS [24]开创了这一类,将高斯人平整为有明确定义的常态的2D冲浪.
后期作品采用平面[10]或四面体[85]原始人,以封闭的形式将深度和常态进行光泽化[80],以单相前缀监督常态[13],或将高斯人视为斯多克固体[81].

blocks.en:
The second class defines a field directly from the Gaussians and extracts its level set with marching tetrahedra on a Delaunay tetrahedralization of Gaussian-derived points.
GOF [ 79 ] introduced this approach with an opacity field, which SOF [ 55 ] evaluates faster by sorting the Gaussians along each ray.
MILo [ 23 ] learns signed distances at nine pivots per Gaussian and extracts a mesh during training, whose rendered depth and normals regularize the Gaussians.
Gaussian Wrapping [ 21 ] treats each Gaussian as an oriented surface element whose vacancy field yields detailed meshes.
Other works jointly optimize the Gaussians with a neural signed [ 12 , 77 , 43 , 84 ] or unsigned [ 33 ] distance field, or align the Gaussians with the surface and reconstruct a mesh by Poisson reconstruction [ 22 ] .
All of these methods assume a static scene.
blocks.zh:
二等从高斯人直接定义出一字段,并取出在高斯人衍生出点的德劳奈四面体化上行走的四面体所设置的地平面.
GOF [79] 引入了这个带有不透明字段的方法,SOF [55]通过沿每道射线分拣高斯人来更快地评价.
MILO [23] 在每高斯人9个比沃特人时学习签名距离,并在训练中提取出一个网状物,使深度和常态化的高斯人.
高斯环 [21] 将每个高斯人视为面向地表元素,其空缺场能产生详细的网格.
其他作品联合优化高斯人,用一个被签名的神经 [12,77,43,84] 或未签名的 [33] 相距场,或将高斯人与地表相接并重建出由波森重建 [22].
所有这些方法都假设了一个静态场景.

blocks.en:
Both radiance fields and Gaussian splatting have been extended from static to dynamic scenes.
For radiance fields, a common approach [ 54 , 51 , 61 , 52 ] is to warp rays into a canonical space with a learned deformation field.
Other works condition the field on time [ 40 , 34 ] or factorize it into space-time feature planes [ 20 , 8 ] .
For Gaussians, 4DGS [ 70 ] and Deformable-3DGS [ 73 ] carry over the canonical-deformation approach [ 54 , 51 , 61 , 52 ] , and many later methods follow it [ 38 , 4 , 88 ] .
Other methods drive the Gaussians by blending the rigid motions of a sparse set of control nodes [ 25 , 32 , 65 ] .
Another line of works models per-Gaussian motion explicitly.
Dynamic3DGS [ 42 ] pioneered this direction, storing each Gaussian’s position and rotation at every frame.
Later methods make this motion more compact and expressive, either with Gaussians whose position and opacity vary over time [ 74 , 37 , 16 , 72 , 68 ] , or by parameterizing each trajectory with keyframes, splines, or other temporal bases [ 27 , 31 , 50 , 62 ] .

对于发光地,一个共同的方法[54,51,61,52]是将射线曲向有学识的变形地的克能空间.
其他工程则使场能按时[40,34]或将其纳入时空地物平面[20,8].
对高斯人来说,4DGS [70]和可变形-3DGS [73] 延续了犬形变形方法[54,51,61,52],许多后期方法沿用了它[38,4,88].
其他方法通过将一组稀少的控制节点的刚性运动相混合来驱动高斯人[25,32,65].
另一行工程模型 每一个高斯运动。
Dynamic3DGS [42] 开创了这个方向,存储了每个高斯人的位置并在每个相框上旋转.
后期方法使这个运动更加紧凑和表现力更强,或者与地位和不透明度随时间而变化的高斯人[74,37,16,72,68],或者通过将每个轨迹与键框,线条或其他时间基参数化[27,31,50,62].

blocks.en:
The methods above are trained for appearance alone, with no dedicated representation of the surface.
Dynamic surface reconstruction methods initially addressed this with neural implicit surfaces that deform or evolve a signed distance function over time [ 6 , 59 , 67 , 45 , 17 , 75 ] .
More recently, Gaussian-based dynamic surface reconstruction methods have emerged, in three forms.
Hybrid NeRF–Gaussian methods [ 35 , 29 ] couple dynamic Gaussians with a volume-rendered signed distance function.
Hybrid mesh–Gaussian methods [ 44 , 87 , 60 ] bind Gaussians to an input mesh that they deform or track over time.
Lastly, Gaussian-only methods [ 39 , 7 , 83 , 66 , 11 , 71 ] represent the surface with oriented or flattened Gaussians and extract each frame’s mesh by volume integration of rendered depth or by Poisson reconstruction.
Across all three groups, most methods target isolated objects with foreground masks and rely on bounded volumetric grids or input meshes to recover the surface, which keeps them from reconstructing complete dynamic scenes.
blocks.zh:
以上方法仅用于外观训练,没有专门的表面表现.
动态地表重建方法最初用神经内含的表面来解决这个问题,这些表面随着时间的推移会变形或演化出一个已签名的距离函数[6, 59, 67, 45, 17, 75].
最近,基于高斯的动态地表重建方法以三种形式出现。
混合式尼弗-高斯方法[35、29] 高斯人具有量递增的签名距离功能.
Hybrid mesh–Gausian方法 [44, 87, 60] 将高斯人绑入一个输入网,它们随着时间的推移变形或跟踪.
最后,高斯独活法[39、7、83、66、11、71]代表地表有方向或平整的高斯自活法,通过积分化深度或由波森重建提取出每帧网格。

blocks.en:
Given multi-view videos of a dynamic scene captured by synchronized and calibrated cameras, MEMO reconstructs persistent oriented Gaussians whose geometry is defined at every time t ∈ [ 0 , 1 ] t\in[0,1] .
Geometry is represented with the oriented normals proposed in Gaussian Wrapping [ 21 ] , and our motion model computes each Gaussian’s position, rotation, and normal at any time t t ( Sec. 4.1 ).
Before training, we initialize each Gaussian’s trajectory by fitting its motion model to point tracks spanning the sequence ( Sec. 4.2 ).
Training then optimizes all parameters with photometric and geometric losses ( Sec. 4.3 ).
After training, a mesh can be extracted directly at any frame with marching tetrahedra on the Gaussians evaluated at that time.
An overview of our full pipeline is shown in Fig. 2 .

blocks.en: 4.1 Motion Model
blocks.zh: 4.1 动议模式

blocks.en:
MEMO attaches a temporal model to every Gaussian, encoding motion as displacements from a base position and rotation at each query time t t .
Assuming locally rigid motion, the scale of each Gaussian stays constant.
The displacements are modeled as a linear combination of temporal Gaussian kernels, where each kernel is centered around a different inducing time.
Since the kernels cover the whole timeline, the model holds at every frame, so opacity can remain constant as well.
This ensures that every Gaussian remains active at every frame, whereas prior works vary opacity over time [ 74 , 37 , 16 , 72 , 68 ] because their motion models hold only within short windows.

假设局部刚性运动,每个高斯人的规模保持不变.
迁移被模拟为时间高斯内核的线性组合,每个内核都以不同的诱导时间为中心.
由于内核覆盖了整个时间段,模型在每个帧上都坚守住,因此不透明度也可以保持不变.
这保证了每个高斯人仍然活跃在每个帧上,而之前的作品则随时间而变化不一[74,37,16,72,68],因为其运动模型只停留在短窗内.

blocks.en:
Our model is inspired by Gaussian processes (GPs) [ 56 ] , whose posterior mean is also a weighted sum of kernels.
While a GP solves for its weights in closed form with fixed inducing points and kernel lengthscale, we relax both and learn them jointly with the weights during training.
Unlike deformation fields [ 70 , 73 ] and control points [ 25 ] , which share motion among neighboring Gaussians, and polynomial trajectories [ 37 , 68 ] , which hold only within short windows, our model gives each Gaussian its own motion over the whole sequence.
Concretely, each Gaussian G i G_{i} carries two sets of M pos M_{\text{pos}} and M rot M_{\text{rot}} temporal Gaussian kernels, for position displacements and changes in rotation (represented as quaternions), respectively.
Each kernel takes the form k i , m ​ ( t ) = exp ⁡ ( − ( t − τ i , m ) 2 2 ​ ℓ i 2 ) , k_{i,m}(t)=\exp\!\left(-\frac{(t-\tau_{i,m})^{2}}{2\ell_{i}^{2}}\right), (4) where τ i , m \tau_{i,m} is the kernel’s learnable inducing time (its center) and ℓ i \ell_{i} is a learnable lengthscale, one per set, that controls its width.
A set’s inducing times are confined through a sigmoid to disjoint bins of width 1 / M pos 1/M_{\text{pos}} or 1 / M rot 1/M_{\text{rot}} across the unit interval, preventing clustering and ensuring full coverage of the timeline.
Similarly, the lengthscale is a sigmoid of a learned parameter, initialized to the bin width of its set so that neighboring kernels overlap.

blocks.en: 4.2 Initialization
blocks.zh: 4.2 初始化

blocks.en:
Dynamic scenes often contain large and fast motion, such as swinging limbs or spinning parts.
Such motion is challenging for any motion model, since photometric gradients only guide a Gaussian toward nearby image content.
One way to mitigate this challenge is to start from a good initial approximation of the motion.
Most prior methods, however, forgo this approach and start from a static model [ 70 , 73 , 39 ] or from zero motion [ 62 , 25 , 83 ] .
Others approximate the motion only between consecutive frames [ 42 , 68 ] , where large displacements can divert trajectories.
Our initialization scheme instead finds for each Gaussian G i G_{i} a 3D trajectory spanning the entire sequence, using a closed-form fit to tracks built from per-frame SfM points, so that large and fast motion is captured before training begins.
blocks.zh:
动态场景往往包含大而快的动作,例如摆动的四肢或旋转的部分.
这种运动对任何运动模型都具有挑战性,因为光度梯度只引导高斯人走向附近的图像内容.
减轻这一挑战的一个方法是从动议的最初接近开始。
然而,大多数先前的方法都放弃了这种方法,从静态模型[70、73、39]或从零运动[62、25、83]开始。

Our initialization runs once before training and takes as input a sparse COLMAP [ 58 ] point cloud at every frame, as in [ 37 , 68 ] .
First, we link these points into 3D tracks over the entire sequence.
We begin by selecting one or more anchor frames according to the scene.
A single anchor at the first or middle frame suffices when the moving content is visible there, whereas scenes whose content is revealed over time use several anchors spread across the sequence.
Since every anchor starts a new track for each of its points, including static ones, scenes dominated by a static background use few anchors.
From each anchor, a Kalman filter [ 26 ] then runs forward and backward through the sequence, associating each point with the nearest point to its predicted position.
Implausible matches are rejected with a Mahalanobis gate, in which case the track follows the motion of its nearest accepted neighbors instead of being diverted.
The tracks of all anchors are united.
blocks.zh:
我们的初始化在训练前曾运行过一次,并将每个框架的COLMAP[58]点云作为输入,如[37,68]。

我们首先根据场景选择一个或多个锚框.
当移动的内容在那里可见时,第一个或中间帧的单一锚就足够了,而随着时间的推移,其内容被揭示的场景则使用分散在序列中的若干锚.
由于每个锚都为它的每个点,包括静态点,开启了一条新轨迹,因此以静态背景为主的场景很少使用锚.
从每个锚上,一个卡尔曼滤波器[26]再通过序列向上并后行,将每个点与最接近的点连接到它的预测位置.
不可否认的比赛用马哈拉诺比斯门拒绝,在这种情况下,赛道遵循其最近被接受的邻居的运动,而不是被转道.
所有锚地的轨迹都是统一的.

Each spawned Gaussian inherits the motion weights of its nearest tracked Gaussian. Figure 4 shows the Kalman tracks and the trajectories fitted to them.

blocks.en: 5.1 Experimental Setup
blocks.zh: 5.1 实验设置

blocks.en:
Evaluating dynamic surface reconstruction requires ground-truth geometry.
To that end, we introduce Blender-Moments, a benchmark of nine animated scenes rendered in Blender ( Fig. S6 ), from articulated machinery to deforming animals and characters, each 100 to 170 frames long.
Every frame is rendered from 50 training and 10 test cameras around the scene, and a ground-truth mesh can be exported from the animation at any frame.
While DG-Mesh [ 39 ] also provides ground-truth meshes, it is a single-view dataset, outside the scope of our multi-view setting.
To demonstrate the robustness of MEMO on real footage, we complement Blender-Moments with six scenes of Neural 3D Video [ 34 ] and seven scenes of SelfCap [ 72 ] .
blocks.zh:
评价动态地表重建需要地面-真实几何。
为此,我们引入了Blender-Moments,这是由由由Blender(图S6)所制作的9个动画场景构成的基准,从清晰的机械到变形动物和人物,每个100到170帧长.
每个相框由50个训练和10个测试相机在现场周围提供,任何相框都可以从动画中输出出一个地真网.
虽然DG-Mesh [39] 也提供了地-地-地-地-地-地-地-地-地-地-地-地-地-地-地-地-地-地-地-地-地-地-地-地-地-地-地-地-地-地-地-地-地-地-地-地-地-地-地-地-地-地-地-地-地-地-地-地-地-地-地-地-地-地-地-地-地-地-地-地-地-地-地-地-地-地-地-地-地-地-地-地-地-地-地-地-地-地--地---地-地----------------------地---------------------------------------------------------
为了展示MEMO在真实镜头中的坚固性,我们用"神经3D视频"的6个场景"Blender-Moments"[34]和"SelfCap [72]"的7个场景来补充Blender-Moments.

blocks.en:
We compare against five dynamic Gaussian splatting methods, 4DGS [ 70 ] , Deformable-3DGS [ 73 ] , SC-GS [ 25 ] , FreeTimeGS [ 68 ] , and AST-3DGS [ 62 ] , and two geometry-based dynamic methods, D-2DGS [ 83 ] and DG-Mesh [ 39 ] .
For all baselines except DG-Mesh, we extract meshes by TSDF fusion [ 14 ] of the rendered depth maps.
DG-Mesh instead relies on differentiable Poisson reconstruction [ 53 ] during both training and inference.
This restricts DG-Mesh to bounded foreground objects and rules out the real scenes, so we evaluate it on Blender-Moments only.
blocks.zh:
我们比较了五种动态高斯平板方法,4DGS [70],可变形-3DGS [73],SC-GS [25],FreetimeGS [68],和AST-3DGS [62],以及两种基于几何的动态方法,D-2DGS [83]和DG-Mesh [39].
除了DG-Mesh外,所有基线, 我们通过TSDF核聚变取出 meshes [14] 的深度图。
DG-Mesh则在训练和推论期间依靠不同的Poisson重建[53].
这限制了DG-Mesh对前方对象的限定,排除了真实的场景,所以我们只在Blender-Moments上评价.

blocks.en:
We evaluate novel-view synthesis, geometry, and runtime.
For novel-view synthesis, we report PSNR, SSIM [ 69 ] , and LPIPS [ 82 ] on the held-out views of all datasets.
For geometry, we compare meshes qualitatively on all datasets and quantitatively on Blender-Moments.
In each Blender-Moments scene, we extract ground-truth meshes at ten evenly spaced frames.
We measure position with the Chamfer distance and orientation with the normal Chamfer distance [ 46 ] , but neither suffices alone.
Point distances barely penalize surface noise, so a noisy mesh can outscore a clean one, while normal angles can miss a significant surface offset.
Our primary metric is therefore a joint F-score, which requires matched points to agree both in position (distance within 1% of the scene’s bounding-box diagonal) and in orientation (normals within 20 ∘ ).
We compute the normal metrics both on surface samples and on normals rendered at the test views.
For runtime, we report training time.
For fairness, all methods run on a single NVIDIA A100 GPU with 80GB of VRAM.

对于小说-观点综合,我们报告PSNR,SSIM [69],和LPIPS [82] 所有数据集的搁置视图.
就几何学而言,我们对所有数据集和Blender-Moments数据进行定性比较。
在每一个Blender-Moments的场景, 我们提取地面真实的 meshes 在10个均匀的相框。
我们用Chamfer距离测量位置,用正常的Chamfer距离测量方向[46],但光靠这一点是不够的。
相距点几乎不会惩罚表面噪声,因此出声的网状点可以比干净的网状点多出分数,而正常角度则会错失显著的表面相抵.
因此,我们的主要衡量标准是F-分数,这需要匹配的分数才能在位置(距离场景的一角-框对角线以内)和方向(通常在20分以内)上达成一致。

blocks.en:
We compare MEMO with the baselines in geometry, novel-view synthesis, and efficiency, and ablate its components.
The supplement adds per-scene results, mesh comparisons with all baselines, and the complete ablation study.

blocks.en:
MEMO reconstructs the cleanest meshes ( Fig. 5 ), and on Blender-Moments, where ground-truth geometry is available, they also score best in normal accuracy and joint F-score ( Tab. 1(a) ).
Across all methods, the joint F-score agrees with the visual quality of the meshes, whereas the Chamfer distance barely penalizes their noise.
blocks.zh:
MEMO重建了最清洁的中间点(图5),在Blender-Moments上,在地面真实几何上,它们也会在正常的准确度和F-分数(图1(a))中得分最好。
在所有方法中,联合F-分数都同意 meshes 的视觉质量,而Chamfer距离几乎不会惩罚他们的噪音.

blocks.en:
Both the representation and its extraction account for our lead.
Meshed by TSDF fusion, MEMO still surpasses every baseline in normal accuracy and joint F-score.
Marching tetrahedra on the vacancy field improves on both TSDF fusion and Poisson reconstruction.
This advantage comes from sampling the field at the Gaussians, which follow the geometry, so the mesh has an adaptive resolution that is finer where the surface has more detail.
In contrast, TSDF fusion and Poisson reconstruction solve on a fixed grid, where finer detail requires a finer grid everywhere and thus larger, more complex meshes.
Poisson reconstruction further oversmooths the surface and requires watertight, segmented objects, as our meshes reconstructed by Poisson show ( Tab. 1(a) ).
blocks.zh:
代表及其提取 说明我们的领导。
MEMO在TSDF聚变作用下,仍然在正常精度和F-分数上超过每个基准.
在空地上行走"四赫德拉"可以改善TSDF聚变和Poisson重建.
这种优势来自于在高斯山脉上采样出场,这跟随了几何,因此网格具有适应性分辨率,在地表有更细细的地方更细.
相形之下,TSDF聚变和Poisson重建在固定的网格上解决,其中更细细的细节需要在所有地方有更细的网格,从而更大,更复杂的网格.
Poisson重建进一步过度地表平地,需要紧闭水分的物体,正如由Poisson(Tab. 1(a))所展示的我们的网格重建。

blocks.en:
Our representation of geometry does not come at the cost of appearance.
On every dataset, MEMO performs comparably to the dynamic splatting methods that model appearance only, and it renders the best novel views on Blender-Moments and the best PSNR and SSIM on SelfCap ( Tab. 1(a) ).
It also keeps fast-moving parts sharp where other methods blur them ( Fig. 6 ).
Unlike our method, the other two geometry-based methods lose image quality ( Tab. 1(a) ).
DG-Mesh [ 39 ] renders far below every other method, and the quality of D-2DGS [ 83 ] does not translate from Blender-Moments to the real scenes.
blocks.zh:
我们代表几何并不以外观为代价。
在每一个数据集上,MEMO都比照只有模型外观的活泼的镀层方法进行操作,它使Blender-Moments上的最佳新颖观点以及SelfCap上最好的PSNR和SSIM(Tab 1(a)).
在其他方法使其模糊的地方(图6),它也使快速移动的部件保持尖锐.
与我们的方法不同,其他两种以几何为主的方法会失去图像质量(Tab 1(a).
DG-Mesh [39] 制作量远远低于所有其他方法,D-2DGS [83] 的质量并没有从 Blender-Moments 翻译为真实场景.

blocks.en: 6 Discussion
blocks.zh: 讨论

blocks.en:
Although MEMO recovers accurate meshes of complete dynamic scenes, it has several limitations.
First, it extracts each frame’s mesh independently, so consecutive meshes are not guaranteed to share vertices or faces, and extracting temporally consistent meshes remains future work.
Second, its motion relies on the initial tracks, so thin, fast-moving parts that the tracker misses can be smeared or lost.
Third, since every Gaussian stores its own motion, its model is the largest among the compared methods.
Finally, like other methods that reconstruct geometry from images, it is affected by the ambiguity between albedo and shading and by narrow camera baselines, which can leave reliefs in the mesh or weakly constrained depth. Section A discusses these limitations in depth, and Fig. S1 illustrates its failure cases.
blocks.zh:
虽然MEMO恢复了完整的动态场景的准确的网格,但它有多个局限性.
首先,它独立地提取出每个帧的网格,因此连续的网格不能保证共享顶点或相貌,抽取时间上一致的网格仍然是未来的工作.
第二,它的运动依赖于最初的轨迹,如此薄薄而快速地移动的部分,以至于追踪器被错过会被抹去或丢失.
第三,由于每个高斯人存储自己的运动,其模型是比较方法中最大的.
最后,同从影像中重建几何学的其他方法一样,它也受到反照率和阴影度之间的模糊和相机基线狭窄的影响,这可能会使网状或被弱限制的深度产生解脱. 节次 A深入讨论了这些局限性,Fig.S1说明了其失败情况。

blocks.en:
We presented MEMO, which jointly reconstructs the appearance and geometry of complete dynamic scenes.
Its per-Gaussian temporal motion model represents each Gaussian’s motion over the whole sequence, so its geometry is defined at every frame.
A track-based initialization further lets it recover large and fast motion.
We also introduced Blender-Moments, a multi-view benchmark with ground-truth meshes at every frame.
MEMO extracts the most accurate per-frame meshes while keeping novel-view synthesis and training time on par with the strongest dynamic splatting methods.
blocks.zh:
我们介绍了MEMO,它共同重建了完整的动态场景的外观和几何.
它的普-高斯时间运动模型代表了每个高斯人在整个序列上的运动,因此其几何学在每个帧上都有定义.
基于轨迹的初始化进一步使其恢复了大而快的运动.
我们还引入了Blender-Moments,一个多视图基准,每个框架都有地面真实的网格。
MEMO提取出最准确的每帧元件,同时使新颖视角合成和培训时间与最强活泼的活泼花样法保持平起平坐.

blocks.en:
MEMO extracts the mesh of each frame independently, so consecutive meshes are not guaranteed to share vertices or faces.
This has two causes, the lack of a single tetrahedralization that stays valid over the whole sequence, and the vacancy field, which changes over time.
As the Gaussians move and rotate, their pivots shift and the structure of the tetrahedralization changes with them, especially under articulated motion and for parts hidden during part of the sequence, such as the pages of Book or the engine bay of Toyota.
Even if a stable tetrahedralization existed, the time-varying vacancy field would change which edges its 0.5 level set crosses, and with them the output of marching tetrahedra.
Extracting temporally consistent meshes is left for future work.
blocks.zh:
MEMO独立取出每个帧的网格,因此连续的网格不能保证共享顶点或相貌.
这有两个原因,一个是缺乏单一的四面体化,在整个序列中保持有效,另一个是空缺领域,随着时间的变化而变化.
随着高斯人行走和旋转,他们的平地移位和四面体化的结构随它们而变化,特别是在清晰的运动下以及部分序列中隐藏的部分,如"书"的页或丰田的引擎湾.
即使存在稳定的四面体化,时间变化的空缺场也会改变它的0.5平方位相接的相接点,随之而来的是行走四面体的输出.
抽取暂时一致的网格留待今后工作。

blocks.en:
Thin, fast-moving parts are hard to track, and the initialization of MEMO ( Sec. 4.2 ) may miss them.
Training then struggles to recover their motion, since a Gaussian receives gradients only from the pixels it covers.
Without a good initial track, a thin part that moves far between frames has either no Gaussians or static Gaussians.
In the latter case, the Gaussians match the part in a single frame, but in the others they occlude what lies behind them and increase the rendering error, so training lowers their opacity.
Either way, the part is smeared or lost. Figure 1(a) shows two instances, the rotating knob of Lego and the spinning wheel spokes of Bicycle.
blocks.zh:
薄,快移动的部件难以追踪,而MEMO的初始化(第4.2条)可能会错过.
因为高斯人只能从它覆盖的像素中获得梯度。
没有良好的初始音轨,在相框相距相距相去相去甚远的细小部分要么没有高斯人,要么没有静止高斯人.
在后一种情况下,高斯人以一帧相匹配部分,但在后一种情况下,他们占据了后面的东西并增加了渲染错误,因此训练降低了他们的不透明度.
无论哪种方式,该部分被抹去或丢失。 图1(a)显示两种情况,一是乐高的旋转节点,一是自行车的旋转轮声。

blocks.en:
As with other methods that reconstruct geometry from appearance, MEMO faces the ambiguity between albedo and shading.
Sharp appearance boundaries, whether from lighting or from texture, can leave a relief in the mesh, as shown in Fig. 1(b) .
Using multiple viewpoints per frame keeps the ambiguity to a minimum.
blocks.zh:
与其他从外观重建几何方法一样,MEMO面临反照率和阴影的模糊.
如图1(b)所示,无论是从照明还是从纹理来看,尖锐的外观界限都可以在网格中留下解脱.
每个帧使用多个角度,将模糊度保持在最小.

blocks.en:
A narrow, front-facing camera rig, as in Neural 3D Video [ 34 ] , sees surfaces parallel to its image planes with little parallax, which can leave their depth weakly constrained.
Such a surface can then be displaced toward the cameras while still rendering correctly from the training views, as shown in Fig. 1(c) .
blocks.zh:
狭长的前置相机钻机,如"神经3D Video [34]"中,看到表面与它的图像平面平行,几乎没有等 Parlax,这可以使其深度被弱限制.
如图1(c)所示,这样一地表就可以向相机移动,同时仍然从训练角度正确渲染。

blocks.en:
MEMO has the largest models among the compared methods, on average 46% larger than those of FreeTimeGS [ 68 ] , the second largest.
Although MEMO uses about 3 times fewer Gaussians than FreeTimeGS, each of its Gaussians stores about 4 times more parameters.
Fixing the inducing times and lengthscales at their initial values reduces the memory footprint by 18 to 20% at a cost of up to 0.6 dB in PSNR.
Adapting the number of kernels to each Gaussian’s motion, as AST-3DGS [ 62 ] does with its keyframes, would reduce it further, and we leave it to future work.
blocks.zh:
MEMO在比较方法中拥有最大的模型,平均比FreeTimeGS[68]的模型大46%,是第二大.
虽然MEMO使用的高斯人比FreeTimeGS少了大约3倍,但每个高斯人存储的参数大约是4倍.
将诱导时间和长度尺度固定在初始值上,将内存足迹减少18%至20%,成本在PSNR中可达0.6分贝.
让内核的数量适应每个高斯人的运动,就像AST-3DGS [62] 的键框一样,将进一步减少内核数量,我们把它留给未来工作。

blocks.en: Appendix B Implementation Details
blocks.zh: 附录B 细节

blocks.en: B.1 Lifting static components to 4D
blocks.zh: B.1 将静态组件提升到4D

blocks.en:
Three components of MEMO come from methods for static scenes, the importance-based densification and simplification of Mini-Splatting2 [ 19 ] , the 3D filter of Mip-Splatting [ 78 ] , and the normal-error densification of Gaussian Wrapping [ 21 ] .
Each relies on its own sweep over all the training views, which accumulates per-Gaussian statistics.
A naive extension to dynamic scenes would be to sweep over every training view at every frame.
However, this is time-consuming and largely redundant, since neighboring Gaussians move coherently and their relative arrangement changes little between consecutive frames.
Instead, we set a budget of N N views per sweep ( Tab. S1 ).
If a full sweep over V V training views and T T frames exceeds it, the sweep renders the training views of every K K -th frame only, with K = ⌊ V ​ T / N ⌋ K=\lfloor VT/N\rfloor .
Below, we briefly review each component and describe how we lift it to 4D.
blocks.zh:
MEMO的三个组件来自静态场景的方法,基于重要性的收缩和简化迷你电镀2 [19],Mip-Splateting的3D滤波器 [78],和高斯包装的正常-更重的收缩 [21].
每个人依靠自己对所有训练观点的扫荡,这些观点积累了每名高斯人的统计数据.
对动态场景的天真延伸就是在每一帧的每一个训练场景上横扫.
然而,这很花时间,而且在很大程度上是多余的,因为相邻的高斯人动作一致,他们的相对安排在相接的帧间变化不大.
相反,我们设定了每次扫描的N视图预算(Tab.S1)。
如果对 V V 训练视图和 T 帧的全扫描超过它,则该扫描会使得每个 K K - 第 帧的训练视图仅由 K = QQ V T / N = QQ K=\llode VT/N\rlode 构成.
下面我们简要回顾每个部分,并描述我们如何将其提升到4D.

blocks.en:
Mini-Splatting2 [ 19 ] complements the gradient-based densification of 3DGS [ 28 ] with an importance-based pipeline.
The importance of a Gaussian is its accumulated blending weight across all the training views.
The pipeline densifies the scene by cloning the most important Gaussians while pruning negligible ones (aggressive cloning), and later simplifies it in two events that prune the least important Gaussians.
Since aggressive cloning densifies the scene much faster, densification ends at iteration 3K instead of 15K.
During training, Mini-Splatting2 also reinitializes the Gaussians from points sampled on the rendered depth, which removes floaters and Gaussians hidden behind surfaces.
blocks.zh:
迷你电镀2 [19] 以重要管线来补充基于梯度的3DGS [28] 密度.
高斯人的重要性在于,在所有培训观点中,高斯人积累了混合的分量。
输油管通过克隆最重要的高斯人而同时挤出可忽略不计的(侵略性克隆)来使场景变质,而后又在将最不重要的高斯人推倒的两起事件中加以简化.
由于侵略性克隆使场景变形速度快得多,变形以重迭3K而不是15K结束.
在训练期间,"迷你平板"2还从被渲染深度上取样的点上重新将高斯人进行初始化,从而去除了浮体和被隐藏在地表后的高斯人.

blocks.en:
To lift Mini-Splatting2 to 4D, we accumulate importance separately for each sampled frame.
Each aggressive cloning event selects the Gaussians to clone by their importance summed over all sampled frames.
Both the cloning and the simplification events prune a Gaussian only if it is unimportant in every sampled frame.
Gaussians visible in only a few frames, such as parts hidden during most of the sequence, therefore survive pruning.
We drop the depth reinitialization, since replacing the Gaussians would discard their trajectories.
blocks.zh:
为了将Mini-Splating2提升到4D,我们为每个被取样的帧分别积累了重要性.
每一次侵略性克隆事件都会根据它们在所有被取样的框架上的重要性来选择高斯人进行克隆.
克隆和简化事件只有在每一个抽样框架都不重要的情况下才会成为高斯人。
高斯人只可见于少数帧中,如大部分序列中隐藏的部分,因此能活下来被打磨.
我们放弃了深度 重新初始化, 因为取代高斯人会放弃他们的轨迹。

blocks.en:
Mip-Splatting [ 78 ] prevents aliasing by ensuring that each Gaussian is at least as large as a pixel of the training views that see it.
It convolves each Gaussian with an isotropic Gaussian kernel the size of a pixel at the closest of these views, and scales the opacity down so that the total contribution of each Gaussian is preserved.
This size is determined by the Gaussian’s distance to the cameras, which varies from frame to frame in a dynamic scene.
To lift the filter to 4D, we determine each Gaussian’s kernel size from its closest distance to the training views over the whole sequence, according to its position at each sampled frame.
As in Mip-Splatting, we recompute the filter whenever Gaussians are added or removed, and periodically after densification to account for the optimization updates.
Since each recomputation evaluates the motion model at every sampled frame, we increase the period from 100 to 1K iterations to reduce training time.
blocks.zh:
Mip-Splating [78] 通过确保每个高斯人至少能像素一样大来防止异名化身被看到的培训观点.
它将每个高斯人与最接近这些视图的像素大小的异地高斯人内核相交,并缩放不透明度,以保留每个高斯人的总贡献.
这种大小由高斯人与相机的相距决定,相机在动态场景中因相框而异.
为了将过滤器提升到4D,我们根据其在被采样的每一帧的位置,确定每个高斯人的内核大小,从最近的距离到整个序列的训练视图.
和在Mip-Splating中一样,每当高斯人被添加或去除时,我们都会重新计算滤波器,并定期在收缩后对优化更新进行核算.
由于每次重算都会在每个被抽取的相框上评价运动模型,因此我们把周期从100到1K重迭来缩短训练时间.

blocks.en:
Normal-error densification was proposed in Gaussian Wrapping [ 21 ] to close holes in the surfaces.
For each Gaussian, it accumulates the error between its oriented normal and the normal of the rendered depth across the training views.
The Gaussians with the largest error are then cloned with flipped normals, so that either orientation can be kept.
To lift normal-error densification to 4D, we accumulate each Gaussian’s error over all the sampled frames.
blocks.zh:
在高斯环 [21] 中提出了正常-更密集化,以关闭地表孔.
对每个高斯人来说,它会累积其方向的常态和整个训练视野所显示的深度的常态之间的错误。
出错最大的高斯人再被倒转的常态所克隆出,这样两个方向都可以被保持.
为了把正常-更密集的密度提升到4D,我们将每个高斯人的误差累积到所有被采样的相框上.

blocks.en: B.2 Mesh extraction
blocks.zh: B.2 网状提取

blocks.en:
To extract the mesh at time t t , we first apply the motion model and obtain each Gaussian’s position, rotation, and oriented normal at t t .
Then, we follow the two-pivot mesh extraction pipeline of Gaussian Wrapping [ 21 ] .
Each Gaussian contributes two pivots, its center and the point three standard deviations from it along its oriented normal.
The pivots are tetrahedralized with a GPU Delaunay triangulation [ 9 ] .
Next, we evaluate the vacancy at each pivot from the training views captured at t t .
Finally, we extract the mesh as the 0.5 level set of the vacancy with marching tetrahedra.
After extraction, we clean the mesh using the following steps: • We remove faces with a vertex farther from the center of the camera rig than five times its radius. • We remove faces with an edge longer than 0.2 times the rig radius. • We remove connected components of fewer than 5,000 faces. • We remove faces whose barycenter vacancy exceeds the 99th percentile over all faces.
This removes faces that marching tetrahedra places across empty space, for example between two nearby parts or across a depth edge.
blocks.zh:
为了在时间t t 中提取网格,我们首先应用了运动模型,并获得每个高斯人的位置,旋转,并定向在t t 上正常.
然后,我们沿着高斯环绕的两条支线网取出管道[21].
每个高斯人都贡献出两个活口,它的中枢和点三标准偏差沿着它的向常.
平地被用GPU Delaunay三角化来四面体化[9].
接下来,我们评价每个中心点的空缺情况。
最后,我们提取出网格作为0.5级的空缺套装,并有行走的四面体.
提取后,我们用下列步骤来清理网状: 我们用一个顶点从相机钻机中心取出5倍于半径的面孔。 · 我们除去比钻机半径多0.2倍的面孔。 我们删除不到5 000个面孔的连接部件。 我们删除了那些 超过99%的面孔。
这样可以去除四面体四面体 穿过空地, 例如在相邻的两个部分之间, 或者穿过一个深度边缘。

blocks.en: We remove faces with a vertex farther from the center of the camera rig than five times its radius.
blocks.zh: 我们用一个顶点从相机钻机中心取出 比半径多出五倍的脸

blocks.en: We remove faces with an edge longer than 0.2 times the rig radius.
blocks.zh: 我们除去长于钻机半径0.2倍的面孔

blocks.en: We remove connected components of fewer than 5,000 faces.
blocks.zh: 我们移除了不到5 000个面孔的连接部件。

blocks.en:
We remove faces whose barycenter vacancy exceeds the 99th percentile over all faces.
This removes faces that marching tetrahedra places across empty space, for example between two nearby parts or across a depth edge.
blocks.zh:
我们删除了那些 超过99%的面孔
这样可以去除四面体四面体 穿过空地, 例如在相邻的两个部分之间, 或者穿过一个深度边缘。

blocks.en:
By default, the vacancy is evaluated with the 3D mip filter on, which attenuates the Gaussians’ opacity.
This attenuation can affect thin structures, whose Gaussians become nearly transparent, so that the vacancy around them stays just above 0.5 and removes them from the mesh.
We therefore add an opt-in thin-structures mode that evaluates the vacancy with the unattenuated opacities and keeps thin structures intact.
blocks.zh:
默认情况下,空缺会用3D mip过滤器来评估,从而减轻高斯人的不透明度。
这种衰减会影响薄薄的结构,高斯人几乎变得透明,这样周围的空缺就只维持在0.5上方并把它们从网格中去掉.
因此,我们增加一种选入薄结构模式,以未加调整的不透明性来评价空缺,并保持薄结构完好无损。

blocks.en: B.3 Hyperparameters
blocks.zh: B.3 超参数

blocks.en:
To speed up training, we render color, depth, geometric and oriented normals, and alpha in a single pass of a custom CUDA rasterizer built on that of RaDe-GS [ 80 ] .
We keep the densification and simplification schedule of Mini-Splatting2 [ 19 ] , and add normal-error densification [ 21 ] , which runs every 1K iterations from iteration 12K to 16K.
For the geometric losses, we set λ D = 0.02 \lambda_{D}=0.02 and λ N = 0.05 \lambda_{N}=0.05 , and compute the depth normal 𝐍 d \mathbf{N}_{d} from a blend of 0.4 of the expected depth and 0.6 of the median depth. ℒ D \mathcal{L}_{D} and ℒ N \mathcal{L}_{N} start at iterations 3K and 10K, after the importance-based densification and simplification events, respectively.
We set the learning rates of the motion model to 3 × 10 − 5 3\times 10^{-5} for the position weights, inducing times, and lengthscales, and to 5 × 10 − 3 5\times 10^{-3} for those of rotation.
We train for 30K iterations on a single NVIDIA A100 GPU.
We use the default hyperparameters of 3DGS [ 28 ] unless stated otherwise below. Table S1 lists the settings that vary across scenes, and the settings below apply to all scenes unless a dataset is named.
We decay the learning rate of the base positions over the first 18K iterations instead of 30K and, following Gaussian Wrapping [ 21 ] , set the learning rates of the spherical harmonics to 1.3 × 10 − 3 1.3\times 10^{-3} for the base color and 1.1 × 10 − 4 1.1\times 10^{-4} for the higher bands.

Each anchor frame starts Kalman tracks forward and backward through the sequence.
When a track finds no point near its predicted position in the next frame, it follows the motion of its nearest neighbors.
We discard tracks that follow their neighbors in over 90% of the frames.

我们丢掉跟随邻居的轨迹 超过90%的框架。

We remove the boundary inducing times ( B = 0 B=0 ) or keep a single one on each side ( B = 1 B=1 ).
Boundary inducing times significantly improve the quality of the first and last frames ( Tabs. 2(a) and S2 ), whose motion would otherwise be extrapolated from kernels on one side only.
The effect is less prominent on the real scenes, whose frames are dominated by static background.

效果在真实场景中不太突出,其帧被静态背景所支配.

We halve and quarter the number of interior inducing times, M pos M_{\text{pos}} and M rot M_{\text{rot}} , in every scene.
With fewer kernels, the motion model cannot follow fast motion, and both appearance and geometry degrade ( Tab. 2(b) ).
On the real scenes, the drop in PSNR is mild because static background dominates the frames, but the moving parts degrade visibly ( Fig. S3 ).
blocks.zh:
我们把内部诱导次数减半,
由于内核较少,运动模型无法跟随快动,外观和几何都退化了(Tab 2.b.).
在真实的场景中,PSNR的下降是温和的,因为静态背景主导了帧,但移动的部分明显地降解(图. S3.

blocks.en:
In the initialization ( Sec. 4.2 ), we fit each Gaussian’s trajectory to its track.
Here, we discard the fitted trajectories, and initialize every Gaussian with zero motion ( Tab. 2(d) , rightmost column).
Optimization then fails to recover large motion within the training budget, and both appearance and geometry degrade severely on the synthetic scenes.
On the real scenes, PSNR drops only slightly because static background dominates the frames, but fast-moving parts are lost ( Fig. S3 ).
blocks.zh:
在初始化(第4.2节)中,我们把每个高斯人的轨迹与它的轨迹相匹配。
在这里,我们放弃了安装的轨迹, 并初始化每一个高斯人 零运动(Tab 2.d),最右栏。
优化之后在训练预算内无法恢复出大的运动,外观和几何在合成场景上都严重退化.
在真实的场景上,PSNR只因静态背景主导了帧而略有下降,但快动的部分丢失了(图. S3.

Insets show the full Flame salmon frames, with the crop outlined in red.
Spiderman’s hands and Flame salmon’s torch smear at M / 2 M/2 and break up at M / 4 M/4 , while the default M M keeps them sharp.

Scenes whose content is revealed over time are initialized with several anchor frames spread across the sequence.
Here, we scale each scene’s default number of anchors by one half and one quarter, or use a single anchor at the first or middle frame ( Tab. 2(d) ).
The best anchoring differs from scene to scene, and no single setting is best on all of them.
A single anchor suffices when the moving content is visible at the anchor frame, whereas content revealed over time requires anchors spread across the sequence, whose number then matters little.
blocks.zh:
内容随时间推移被披露的相片被初始化,并有多个主播框分布于各个序列.
在这里,我们将每个场景的默认锚数缩放一半和四分之一,或在第一个或中间帧使用单一锚(Tab 2(d)).
最佳地锚因地而异,没有单一地被设置在他们身上最好.
当移动内容在主机架上可见时,一个主机就足够了,而随着时间的推移,所揭示的内容需要分散在整个序列中的主机,而主机的数量则不重要。

blocks.en:
We freeze the inducing times, the lengthscales, or both, keeping only the kernel weights learned ( Tab. 2(e) ).
Frozen inducing times stay at the bin centers, uniformly spread over the sequence, and frozen lengthscales at the bin width.
Learning them slightly improves fast synthetic motion, and leaves the geometry unchanged.
On the real scenes, the effect is not measurable, since static background dominates the frames.
Frozen parameters become constants shared by all Gaussians and need not be stored, which reduces the model size by about 20%, a mitigation of the model size limitation discussed in Sec. A .
blocks.zh:
我们冻结诱导时间,长度尺度,或两者兼有,只保留内核所学到的重量(Tab.2(e).
冰冻的诱导时间停留在宾站中心,统一分布在序列上,冰冻的长度缩放在宾站宽度上.
学习它们会稍微改进快合成运动,使几何学保持不变.
在真实的场景中,效果无法测量,因为静态背景主导了帧.
被冻结的参数成为了所有高斯人共享的常数,不需要被存储,这使得模型大小减少了约20%,这是 Sec. A所讨论模型尺寸限制的缓解.

blocks.en:
We train without ℒ D \mathcal{L}_{D} , without ℒ N \mathcal{L}_{N} , or without both ( Tab. 2(c) ).
Without ℒ N \mathcal{L}_{N} , the oriented normals that guide extraction are left unconstrained, and the surface breaks into holes and fragments.
Without ℒ D \mathcal{L}_{D} , broad surfaces become lumpy and perforated.
Only their combination yields clean meshes ( Fig. S4 ), at a small cost in PSNR.

All meshes were rendered from the test camera.

blocks.en:
In the training section ( Sec. 4.3 ), we argue for the importance-based densification of Mini-Splatting2 [ 19 ] over the slower scheme of static Gaussian Wrapping [ 21 ] , which combines the vanilla densification of 3DGS [ 28 ] with the multi-view loss of GGGS [ 81 ] .
Here, we put this choice to the test by training with the latter scheme ( Tab. 2(f) , and Fig. S4 , rightmost column).
This scheme degrades both appearance and geometry on the synthetic scenes, and improves only the PSNR of the real scenes, slightly.
On the real scenes, it can open holes or distort the geometry in textureless regions ( Fig. S4 ).
It also doubles the model size and the training time.
blocks.zh:
在培训部分(第4.3节)中,我们主张基于重要性的将迷你电镀2 [19] 与静止高斯环绕的较慢计划相提并论,将3DGS [28] 的香草密度与多视图的GGS [81] 损失结合起来.
在此,我们通过对后一项计划(Tab.2(f)和图S4,最右栏)进行培训来测试这一选择。
这个方案使合成场景的外观和几何都退化了,只略微地改进了真实场景的PSNR.
在真实的场景中,它可以打开孔或扭曲无纹理区域中的几何(图. S4.
它还将模型大小和训练时间翻了一番.

blocks.en:
We replace our marching tetrahedra with the extraction routes of the baselines, TSDF fusion of the rendered depth and Poisson reconstruction from the Gaussian centers and normals, on Blender-Moments, the only dataset with ground-truth meshes ( Tab. 1(a) ).
Both routes yield worse normals and joint F-scores than marching tetrahedra on every scene, Poisson reconstruction most clearly ( Fig. S5 ).
Meshed by TSDF fusion, our models still lead every baseline in normal Chamfer and joint F-score, so much of the lead comes from the representation itself.
blocks.zh:
我们用基线的取出路线、TSDF对已变深的聚变以及从高斯中心和正常地区重建的Poisson来取而代之。
这两条路线的正常程度和F-分数都比每场游行四面体更差,普瓦松重建最明显(图S5)。
在TSDF核聚变的作用下,我们的模型仍然在正常的Chamfer和联合F-分数中领先每个基线,所以大部分的领先来自代表本身.

blocks.en:
Figure S5 : Blender-Moments meshes of MEMO extracted by our marching tetrahedra and by the extraction routes of the baselines, TSDF fusion of the rendered depth and Poisson reconstruction from the Gaussian centers and normals, beside the ground truth.
Marching tetrahedra preserves thin and detailed structures, TSDF fusion roughens and breaks them, and Poisson reconstruction melts them into smooth blobs or, on Spiderman, shatters the mesh.
blocks.zh:
图S5:我们行进中的四面体和基线的取出路线、TSDF对已变深的聚变以及从高斯中部和正常地区从高斯山地区重建的波森等地提取的MEMO的Blender-Moments meshes。
穿行四赫德拉保存了薄而细的结构,TSDF聚变粗糙并打破了它们,而波森重建则将它们融为平滑的blobs,或者在蜘蛛人上将网状碎裂.

blocks.en: D.1 The Blender-Moments benchmark
blocks.zh: D.1 Blender-Moments基准

blocks.en:
To build Blender-Moments, we obtained the models from Sketchfab [ 2 ] , Objaverse [ 15 ] , and the NeRF synthetic dataset [ 47 ] .
We used or modified the existing animations of models that had them, and created animations for models that did not, yielding nine scenes of 100 to 170 frames ( Fig. S6 ).
Each scene is captured by a fixed rig of 50 training and 10 test cameras, sampled uniformly at random on the upper hemisphere around the scene, and rendered in Blender [ 1 ] Cycles at 800 × 800 800\times 800 pixels.
Ground-truth meshes can be exported at any frame directly from the Blender scene.
Since the meshes of consecutive frames are highly redundant, we choose to export ten per scene, at evenly spaced frames.
blocks.zh:
为了构建Blender-Moments,我们从Sketchfab[2],Objaverse[15]和NeRF合成数据集[47]获得模型.
我们使用或修改了已有的模型的动画,并为没有动画的模型创造了动画,产生了9个100到170帧的场景(图S6.
每个场景被50个训练和10个测试相机的固定钻机所俘获,在现场周围的上半球随机统一取样,并以800×800800\时速800像素的Blender[1]循环制成.
从Blender现场可以直接在任何框架上输出地表真核素。
由于连续相框的网格非常冗余,我们选择每个场景输出出10个相框,均匀相框.

blocks.en: D.2 Real datasets
blocks.zh: D.2 实际数据集

blocks.en:
From Neural 3D Video [ 34 ] , we use all six scenes, downsampled by two to 1352 × 1014 1352\times 1014 pixels.
We hold out the central camera for testing, per the dataset convention.
From SelfCap [ 72 ] , we follow the protocol of FreeTimeGS [ 68 ] on six clips of the Hair, Corgi, and Bike sequences, and add a clip of the Yoga sequence to evaluate a longer sequence.
Each SelfCap clip also holds out one camera for testing.
The SelfCap videos are 3840 × 2160 3840\times 2160 pixels, except for the Bike scenes, which are 1080 × 1080 1080\times 1080 .
Following FreeTimeGS, we undistort every frame.
Undistortion leaves black regions along the image borders, which differ between cameras, so we crop all images of a scene by the smallest margin that removes all the black regions in every camera.
We then downsample the cropped undistorted images by two, except on Bike, where we keep the resulting resolution. Table S3 lists the frames, cameras, and resolution of every scene in both datasets.
blocks.zh:
从"神经3D视频"[34],我们使用全部6个场景,由2到1352×1014 1352\times 1014像素进行下标.

blocks.en: D.3 Data preprocessing
blocks.zh: D.3 数据处理

blocks.en:
To keep the comparisons fair and make sure every method trains on exactly the same data, we built a preprocessing pipeline that produces consistent camera poses and per-frame point clouds.
For each frame, we triangulate a sparse point cloud from the provided camera poses with hloc [ 57 ] and COLMAP [ 58 ] . 1. For each view, we use NetVLAD [ 3 ] to find the five most similar views to match it against. 2. For each view, we extract ALIKED [ 86 ] features. 3. We match the ALIKED features of each view pair from step 1 with RoMa [ 18 ] . 4. We triangulate the matches from the provided poses with COLMAP, and discard the points seen by fewer than three views or with a reprojection error above two pixels. On SelfCap, we relax these thresholds to two views and three pixels. 5. The camera poses provided with the real datasets are slightly inaccurate. We therefore refine them by a bundle adjustment of each frame, with the scale fixed, and average each camera’s refined poses over all frames, since the rig is static.
blocks.zh:
为了保持比较的公平性,确保每一种方法都以完全相同的数据来运行,我们建造了一个预处理管道,它能产生一致相机和每帧点云.
对于每个相框,我们三角地从提供的相机外观上取出一个稀有的点云,并带有hloc [57]和COLMAP [58]. 1. 对于每个视图,我们使用NetVLAD[3]找到最相近的5个视图与之相匹配. 2. 对于每种观点,我们摘录了ALIKED[86]特征。 3. 我们把第1步中每个视图的ALIKED特征与RoMa相匹配。 4. 我们用COLMAP对提供的相配物进行三角测距,并丢弃不到3个视图或两个像素以上的再投射出误差所看到的点。 在SelfCap上,我们将这些阈值放宽到两个视图和三个像素. 5. 提供真实数据集的相机外观略为不准确。 因此,我们通过对每个相框的捆绑调整加以改进,并定出比例尺,而且每台相机精细的相机在所有相框上平均摆放,因为钻机是静止的。

blocks.en:
On the real datasets, the triangulated points cover the static background only sparsely.
Every method therefore also receives a dense point cloud of the static background, from which we remove the moving subject, since the triangulated points already represent it.
On SelfCap, we take the dense point cloud provided with the dataset and remove the subject with a box around it.
Neural 3D Video does not provide dense point clouds, so we extract a dense point cloud for the middle frame of each scene with VGGT- Ω \Omega [ 63 ] and align it to the provided camera poses.
We then remove the subject manually, along with the window panes and frames in scenes with open windows, so that the far field renders through them.
blocks.zh:
在真实的数据集上,三角地点覆盖了静态背景只是很少.
因此,每一种方法也都得到静态背景的密集点云,我们从中去除移动对象,因为三角点已经代表了它.
在"SelfCap"上,我们取出提供数据集的密度点云,并用周围的盒子去除主题.
神经三维 视频不提供稠密点云,所以我们为每个场景的中框提取出密密点云,并配有VGGT-ship [63]\Omega[63],并与所提供的相机平面对齐.
然后,我们手动移除主题, 与窗口窗板和框 在场景中打开窗口, 这样远处的字段就可以通过它们。

blocks.en: D.4 Evaluation protocol
blocks.zh: D.4 评价协议

blocks.en:
We evaluate all methods with the same protocol.
We measure the image quality of the test views on all datasets, the mesh quality on Blender-Moments, the only dataset with ground-truth meshes, and the training time.
For image quality, we compute PSNR, SSIM, and LPIPS with a VGG backbone on every frame of every test camera, and average them over all test images.
The training time is the wall-clock time of training on a single 80GB NVIDIA A100 GPU.
blocks.zh:
我们用同样的程序评估所有方法。
我们测量所有数据集的测试视图的图像质量,Blender-Moments上的网格质量,唯一带有地真网格的数据集,以及训练时间.
对于图像质量,我们计算PSNR,SSIM,以及LPIPS,每台测试相机的每个帧上都有一个VGG主干线,并且在所有测试相机上平均.
训练时间是单人80GB NVIDIA A100 GPU上行走的一站一站一站一站一站的训练时间.

blocks.en:
For mesh quality, we compare each method’s mesh with the ground-truth mesh at the ten evaluated frames of every Blender-Moments scene, and average the metrics over them.
We measure position accuracy with the point Chamfer distance between 200K points sampled uniformly over each mesh’s surface, normalized by the diagonal of the ground-truth bounding box.
Point distances barely penalize surface noise.
A noisy surface that oscillates around the ground truth stays close to it everywhere, so it can outscore a clean surface with a small offset.
Surface noise, however, does affect the normals.
We therefore complement the traditional Chamfer distance with the normal Chamfer distance [ 46 ] , which averages the angle between the normals of nearest samples on the two meshes.
Conversely, normal angles ignore surface offsets.
A surface displaced far from the ground truth, but parallel to it, keeps its normals and still scores perfectly.
blocks.zh:
就网格质量而言,我们把每种方法的网格与每个Blender-Moments场景的10个评估框架的地真相网格进行比较,并平均衡量它们。
我们用200K点之间的差分测量位置精确度,
相距相距很近 表面的噪音不会因此受损
环绕地表的响亮地表 真实性会随处可见 这样它就能比干净地表高分
但是,表面噪音确实影响到正常情况。
因此,我们用正常的Chamfer距离来补充传统的Chamfer距离[46],这个距离是两个中间点上最近样品的正常相距之间的平均值.
相反,正常角度忽略了表面相抵.
表面远离地面的真相,但与之平行,保持了常态,依然得分完美.

blocks.en:
The two Chamfer distances can rank methods in opposite orders.
One method may have a lower point Chamfer distance but a higher normal Chamfer distance than another.
Taken separately, the two scores cannot determine which of the two methods produces higher-quality meshes.
We therefore define a joint F-score, and compute its precision and recall with the following condition.
A sample and its nearest sample on the other mesh form a correct match when their distance is below 1% of the diagonal and their normals differ by less than 20 ∘ 20^{\circ} .
Across all methods, the joint F-score agrees with the visual quality of the meshes more consistently than either the point or the normal Chamfer distance alone ( Sec. 5.2 ), and we therefore use it as our primary geometry metric.
blocks.zh:
两个Chamfer距离可以按相反顺序排列方法.
一种方法可能有一个更低的点Chamfer距离,但比另一种方法的正常Chamfer距离要高.
将两种方法中的哪一种方法分为两种,无法确定两种方法中哪一种方法能产生出质量更高的网点。
因此,我们确定一个F-分数,并以下列条件计算其准确性和召回性。
一个样本和它在其他网状体上最近的样本,当它们的距离低于对角线的1%,它们的常态相差小于20 ∘ 20^{\ Circ}时,形成正确的匹配.
在所有方法中,联合F分数都更一致地认同中间点的视觉质量,而不是光是点或正常的Chamfer距离(第5.2节),因此我们把它作为我们的主要几何测量标准。

Lastly, on SelfCap [ 72 ] , all methods need one post-processing step before evaluation.
The SelfCap cameras stand on a half-circle rig, so parts of the rig appear in the views of the cameras facing them.
Every method reconstructs these parts with floaters near the cameras, which can occlude novel views.
We therefore remove from every method’s model, after training, the Gaussians that lie within 15% of the scene extent from a training camera and inside its frustum.
At inference, we do the same for every novel-view camera.

blocks.zh: 附录E 其他结果

blocks.en:
This section reports additional results.
We give the per-scene results of every method on every dataset, compare the meshes of all methods on Blender-Moments and on the real scenes, including the baselines that the main paper leaves out, add novel-view comparisons on two more SelfCap scenes, and show our meshes over time on several scenes.
Videos of our results on all scenes, compared side by side with every baseline, are available on https://memo-4d.github.io/comparisons.html .

本节报告其他结果。
我们在每个数据集上给出每种方法的平面结果,比较Blender-Moments和真实场景上所有方法的网格,包括主论文所留下的基线,在多出两个"自译自出"场景上加入小说-视角比较,并在多个场景上显示我们随着时间的推移的网格.
我们在所有场景中的结果的视频,与每一基线并列比较,可查阅https://memo-4d.github.io/comparidarisons.html。

blocks.en:
Tables S4 , S5 and S6 report the per-scene results on every dataset.
On Blender-Moments ( Tab. S4 ), MEMO has the best image quality on eight of the nine scenes.
In mesh quality ( Tab. S5 ), while other methods lead the point Chamfer distance on several scenes, MEMO has the best normal Chamfer distance on all but one scene, and the best joint F-scores across the board.
These results are consistent with our analysis of the mesh metrics in Sec. D.4 .
On Neural 3D Video ( Tab. S6 ), no method leads on every scene.
MEMO has the best SSIM on most scenes, while 4DGS has the best mean PSNR and FreeTimeGS the best LPIPS.
On SelfCap, MEMO has the best mean PSNR and SSIM, and FreeTimeGS the best LPIPS.
blocks.zh:
表S4、S5和S6报告每个数据集的人均结果。
在Blender-Moments (Tab. S4)上,MEMO在9个场景中的8个场景上拥有最佳的图像质量.
在网格质量(Tab.S5)中,虽然其他方法在多个场景中领先Chamfer距离,但MEMO除一个场景外,其他所有场景都拥有最佳的普通Chamfer距离,以及最佳的F-分数交叉.
这些结果与我们对Sec.D.4.中的网格测量的分析是一致的。
在神经3D视频(Tab. S6)上,没有方法引导每个场景.
MEMO在大多数场景中拥有最好的SSIM,而4DGS则拥有最好的平分PSNR和FreeTimeGS最佳LPIPS.
在SelfCap上,MEMO拥有最优的平分PSNR和SSIM,而FreetimeGS则是最优的LPIPS.

blocks.en:
Figure S7 extends the mesh comparison of the main paper ( Sec. 5.2 ) to every baseline on six Blender-Moments scenes.
The appearance-only methods produce noisy, fragmented surfaces.
The geometry-based D-2DGS and DG-Mesh produce cleaner surfaces but degrade fine detail, such as the raised page of Book, the tip of the Elephant trunk, the brake cables of Bicycle, and the cabin of Beetle.
MEMO preserves both broad surfaces, such as the pages of Book, and thin structures, such as the brake cables of Bicycle and the seats and steering wheel of Beetle.
blocks.zh:
图S7将主纸(第5.2节)的网格比较扩大到了六个Blender-Moments场景的每个基线.
唯相外观的方法会产生吵闹而零碎的表面.
基于几何学的D-2DGS和DG-Mesh产生更清洁的表面但可降解细微细节,如"书"的高高一页,"大象"干线的尖端,"自行车"的制动电缆,"比特尔"的船舱等.
MEMO既保留了书页等宽地表,也保存了薄地结构,如自行车的制动电缆和比特尔的座椅和方向盘等.

blocks.en:
Figure S8 compares the meshes of all methods except DG-Mesh on the real scenes.
With no ground-truth meshes available, we present the test image of each scene as reference.
The appearance-only methods turn the static background into noisy, crumpled surfaces, most visibly on the walls and blinds of Coffee martini, and blur fine detail, such as the ears of the corgi in Corgi2.
D-2DGS produces smoother surfaces but distorts the geometry and loses detail, such as the wall and the person’s hands and shaker in Coffee martini, the upper wheel in Bike2, and the corgi’s ears and the person’s shoes in Corgi2.
On Yoga and Hair1, its meshes break apart.
MEMO reconstructs clean walls, floors, and furniture, together with the moving subjects and their fine detail, such as the corgi’s ears.
blocks.zh:
图S8在真实场景中比较除DG-Mesh以外的所有方法的网格.
由于没有地面真实的网格,我们将每个场景的测试图像作为参考。
仅以外观为主的手法,将静态背景变成吵闹,平缓的表面,最明显地出现在"咖啡马提尼"的墙上和百叶窗上,并模糊了细微的细节,比如"Corgi2"中的"Corgi"的耳朵.
D-2DGS产生更平滑的表面,但扭曲了几何特征并丢失了细节,例如:墙和人手和握手器在Coffee Martini中,上轮在Bike2中,而克吉耳和人的鞋子在Corgi2中.
在瑜伽和海发1上,它的母体会破裂.
MEMO重建了干净的墙壁、地板和家具,以及移动的主体及其细微细节,例如Corgi的耳朵。

blocks.en:
Figure S9 compares novel views of all methods except DG-Mesh on the real scenes, cropped to the moving subjects, since all methods reconstruct the static background well.
Most baselines blur or distort fast-moving parts, such as the hands and tongs in Cook spinach, the face and knife in Cut roasted beef, the corgi’s head in Corgi1, and the face in Hair1.
SC-GS and D-2DGS smear the entire cook in both Neural 3D Video scenes.
Overall, MEMO renders the moving parts sharper and closer to the ground truth.
Specifically in Hair1, although no method fully recovers the individual strands, MEMO best preserves the flung hair.
blocks.zh:
图S9比较了除DG-Mesh以外的所有方法在真实场景中的新颖观点,被收缩到移动主题,因为所有方法都重建了静态背景井.
大多数基线模糊或扭曲了快速移动的部分,如Cook 菠菜中的手和指头,Cut烤牛肉中的相和刀,Corgi 1中的Corgi头和Hair1中的相相.
SC -GS和D -2DGS在两个神经3D视频场景中都给整个厨师涂抹.
总的来说,MEMO使移动部分更加尖锐并更接近地面真相.
具体地说,在海发1中,虽然没有方法能够完全恢复个体的线条,但MEMO最好保存花发.

blocks.en:
Figure S10 shows MEMO’s meshes over time on five additional Blender-Moments scenes.
Each row follows one motion: the Lego excavator lowering its bucket, the book closing, the Toyota opening its doors, hood, and trunk, Spiderman’s full sequence, and the bicycle steering its front wheel.
The surfaces stay sharp through fast and large motion, and thin structures such as the bicycle’s brake cables persist across frames.
